sequential_dependency.intermediate: The normalized segment cells and the unique segment color whose newly created free endpoint touches the isolated color-4 receiver.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Identify the dominant odd family of parallel segments, infer the commonly aligned endpoint side, and resize every segment to the spatially middle segment length while preserving that endpoint.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Relay that contacted segment color to every color-4 receiver and remote payload cell.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Before normalization the short source segment does not touch the receiver. Inspecting contacts in the original grid yields no relay color, while the normalized endpoint creates the unique contact and changes the final grid.

parametric_work.summary: Source-bound normalize/contact_relay family with 2-6 demonstrations, four sequentially revealed queries, a substantive 30x30 case, 14-rival teaching audit, protected-Racket parity, and a wrong-order witness.

remaining_failures: Owner registration, exact-source review, native qualification, and acceptance remain pending.
The 64-seed finite-rival audit does not establish universal lesson identifiability or measured training benefit.
target.summary: Built a general protected-Racket parallel-segment normalizer and a matched contact-relay alternative; added envelope-safe four-query generation, adversarial lesson repairs, privacy checks, and replayable wrong-order evidence.
